headline: Global river and lake water levels fell sharply during the two hottest years on record
label: NEWS
caption:
New research shows that global freshwater levels dropped significantly during the two hottest years on record.

According to studies reported by the Guardian and BreakingNews.ie, extreme heat in 2023 and 2024 drove unprecedented declines in the world rivers and lakes.

Scientists found that while there was more water in the atmosphere, less water remained in terrestrial rivers.

How will this severe freshwater decline impact communities around the world in the coming years? 👇
